milestone.describes: A campaign battle is fought and resolved: the territory map, an attack, the battlefield, and the map afterwards with the player's territory expanded.

steps.expect: Main menu over a valley: Play, Instructions, Options, Credits.
Mode menu: Campaign, Survival, Multiplayer, Back.
Choose Your Race: two warriors, Archery and Halberd ratings, a difficulty and a race with arrows either side.
Upgrade Army: Money 500, Kills 0, the unit row with Buy Unit and three Empty slots.
The campaign map: coloured territories with armies on them and yellow arrows showing where an attack is possible.
A panel over the map naming the territory, its difficulty and owner, with Attack and Cancel.
The battlefield: spear, sword and archer icons top left, a dial top right, options, and a How To Play overlay.
Back on the campaign map with the player's territory larger than before and new arrows — the battle has been fought and won.

notes: Coordinates are client coordinates for the 480x320 landscape window. Driving this on a scaled display means measuring from a screen capture rather than converting through ClientToScreen; see the playbook.
Some text is drawn mirrored — the two buttons on the race screen, parts of the army screen, and the How To Play overlay — while other text on the same screens is correct. It does not stop the route.
The battle resolves on its own once the overlay is dismissed; no unit control is needed to see the campaign advance.
